description: Format a date relative to a base date in Arabic (e.g. three days ago -> "منذ ٣ أيام"). Defaults the base to now.

base.description: Base/reference date as ISO 8601 string. Defaults to the current time.

date.description: Target date as ISO 8601 string, e.g. '2025-09-20'.

name: format_relative_time
